methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.

actual_scope: On the emitted PR5708 word and its published one-edge route table, move three, four, or five corrections of each A2 conjugation with exactly five contacts onto other frames, leave the remaining corrections on their contact frames, and decide whether any such assignment emits and lowers the paid-query moment on (0,1).
scope_change_reason: The card says to review the #5679/#5708 chain and stop when a proposed cut does not improve the paid moment. #6963 shows that two moved corrections fail to emit at exactly five contacts and leaves the three-or-more question open on the 4,331 tail words. This package takes that question on every length-5 interval: the finite set of assignments that move at least three corrections, not a single tail and not a partial search.
bottleneck_link: A paid-moment obstruction on this exact word says the length-5 three-or-more-move conjugation domain does not raise the ordinary BIT component. It does not change the selected exponent.
stop_rule: Stop when every assignment that moves three or more corrections on the 133 intervals of length exactly 5 is classified. Do not open a length-6 search or a three-move search at 2, 3 or 4 contacts in this package.
